lines.t: I stood beneath the weight of my mistakes,
Echoes of the law I could not break,
But love came running where sorrow stayed,
And mercy spoke, my fear decayed.
No price of mine could ever pay,
The gift of life He gave that day.
Grace—it reigns, unearned, untamed,
Poured like rain through crimson veins.
I was lost, but now I see,
Grace is the river washing me.
Not by the work of trembling hands,
But by His word, His vast commands,
He called the sinner to stand up free,
Grace rewrote my history.
No shadow stands where light has shone,
No guilt remains—His love alone.
Grace—it reigns, unearned, untamed,
Poured like rain through crimson veins.
I was lost, but now I see,
Grace is the river washing me.
It’s higher than the mountains,
Deeper than the grave,
A promise everlasting,
A soul forever saved.
Grace—it reigns, beyond the skies,
The gift of God that never dies.
I fall, He lifts; I’m weak, He stays,
Forever free beneath His grace.
So let every breath and heartbeat say,
I am alive because of grace today.
